summary: Big Pine Sands STOLGround is a small Short Takeoff and Landing (STOL) facility located on Big Pine Key in the Lower Florida Keys. It primarily serves recreational pilots, private aircraft, and visitors heading to the surrounding Keys communities. The airstrip provides convenient access to one of the most scenic and ecologically diverse areas of the Florida Keys archipelago.
faqs:
Q: What type of airport is Big Pine Sands STOLGround?
A: It is a small STOL (Short Takeoff and Landing) airfield designed for light aircraft with short runway requirements, typical of Keys aviation facilities.

Q: Where is the airport located?
A: It is situated on Big Pine Key in Monroe County, Florida, within the Lower Florida Keys chain of islands.

Q: Are commercial flights available at this airport?
A: No, Big Pine Sands STOLGround does not offer scheduled commercial service and is primarily used for private and general aviation.

Q: What is the airport best used for?
A: It is well suited for recreational flying, island hopping within the Keys, and accessing the natural attractions of the surrounding area including the National Key Deer Refuge.
transport_tips: The airport is reachable by car via US Route 1 (the Overseas Highway), the only road connecting the Keys. Parking is typically on-site and informal given the small size of the facility. Visitors without a private aircraft should arrange ground transportation in advance, as there is no public transit directly serving the airfield.
local_tip: Time your visit to coincide with sunrise or sunset over the nearby waters — the unobstructed horizon in the Keys offers some of the best light conditions for aerial photography and sightseeing flights departing from this STOL strip.
